images.prompt: Photoreal photograph, magazine-ad quality, subtle film grain. A plain wooden study desk in an Indian college hostel room, seen perfectly straight-on at eye level, soft daylight from a window out of frame. On the desk stands a simple metal desk organiser holding five upright cardboard file folders side by side in one row, evenly spaced, their front faces turned flat toward the camera; each folder front carries one large plain blank white label card, all five labels identical, completely blank and facing the camera straight on. A steel water bottle and a folded pair of spectacles sit at the edge of the desk. The desk and folders fill the lower 62% of the frame; the top 38% is empty plain pale-cream painted wall. Natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

caption_draft:
Your first resume can be made free with these 5 tools.

Overleaf — https://www.overleaf.com/gallery/tagged/cv — LaTeX templates for résumés
Reactive Resume — https://docs.rxresu.me/use-cases/free-resume-builder — No paywall on downloads
FlowCV — https://flowcv.com/ — 100+ resume templates
Canva Resumes — https://www.canva.com/create/resumes/ — Hundreds of free templates
Google Docs — https://support.google.com/docs/answer/148833?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop — Built-in resume templates

Save this and make your one-page resume this week. Send it to the friend applying for a winter internship.
